title: Balochistan Local Government Elections Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Local Government Elections Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE IX OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL
GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE IX OF 2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the Balochistan Local Government Election Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 21st April, 2001]
No. Legis.-1-122(Law)/2000-II,
dated 21-4-2001.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 16th April, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:---
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Local Government
Elections (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Local Government Elections Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3 of Ordinance VI of 2000

ORDINANCE IX OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL
GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE IX OF 2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the Balochistan Local Government Election Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 21st April, 2001]
No. Legis.-1-122(Law)/2000-II,
dated 21-4-2001.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 16th April, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:---
2. Amendment of section 3 of
Ordinance VI of 2000.--In subsection (3) of section 3, of the Balochistan
Local Government Election Ordinance, 2000, the full stop appearing at the end
shall be substituted by a colon and thereafter the following proviso shall be
added:
"Provided that the appellate
authority shall be appointed if Government authorises an officer to invite
objections of the proposals."
